AfterShow.Source: console.log('UC Init executou', new Date().toISOString(), 'inIframe?', window.self !== window.top);(function bootstrapGX(){  // =============================  // 1) HOST / CONTAINER  // =============================  const root =    (this && typeof this.getContainerControl === 'function' && this.getContainerControl()) ||    (this && typeof this.getContainer === 'function' && this.getContainer()) ||    null;  // Em GeneXus, document.currentScript costuma ser null; então não dependemos dele.  const host = root || document;  function qById(id){    return host.querySelector('#' + CSS.escape(id));  }  function q(sel){    return host.querySelector(sel);  }  function setTextId(id, value){    const el = qById(id);    if(el) el.textContent = value;  }  function setHtmlId(id, html){    const el = qById(id);    if(el) el.innerHTML = html;  }  function showEl(el){    if(!el) return;    el.hidden = false;    el.style.display = '';  }  function showId(id){    showEl(qById(id));  }  function toast(message){    const t = qById('toast');    if(!t) return;    t.textContent = message;    t.style.display = 'block';    clearTimeout(toast._tm);    toast._tm = setTimeout(() => { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 3500);  }  // =============================  // 2) QUERYSTRING (iframe + parent)  // =============================  function qs(name){    let v = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get(name);    if(v) return v;    // tenta no parent apenas se same-origin    try{      v = new URLSearchParams(window.parent.location.search).get(name);      if(v) return v;    }catch(e){}    return null;  }  // =============================  // 3) WAIT DOM (polling + observer)  // =============================  function waitForDomReady(timeoutMs = 12000){    const must = ['currentVersion','latestVersion','notes','kbName'];    const ok = () => must.every(id => !!qById(id));    return new Promise((resolve) => {      const start = Date.now();      if(ok()) return resolve(true);      let obs = null;      const timer = setInterval(() => {        if(ok()){          clearInterval(timer);          if(obs) obs.disconnect();          resolve(true);        } else if(Date.now() - start > timeoutMs){          clearInterval(timer);          if(obs) obs.disconnect();          resolve(false);        }      }, 120);      try{        obs = new MutationObserver(() => {          if(ok()){            clearInterval(timer);            obs.disconnect();            resolve(true);          }        });        const target = (host === document) ? document.documentElement : host;        obs.observe(target, { childList:true, subtree:true });      }catch(e){}    });  }  // =============================  // 4) HELPERS  // =============================  function fmtBytes(bytes){    const n = Number(bytes || 0);    if(!isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return '—';    const units = ['B','KB','MB','GB','TB'];    let v = n, i = 0;    while(v >= 1024 && i < units.length-1){ v/=1024; i++; }    return `${v.toFixed(v >= 10 || i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;  }  function toIntSafe(v){    if(v === null || v === undefined) return null;    const s = String(v).trim();    if(!s) return null;    const m = s.match(/(\d+)(?!.*\d)/);    if(!m) return null;    const n = parseInt(m[1], 10);    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;  }  function updateProgressUI(percent, label){    const bar = qById('progressBar');    const txt = qById('progressText');    if(bar) bar.style.width = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent))}%`;    if(txt) txt.textContent = label || `${percent}%`;  }  // =============================  // 5) API  // =============================  function getApiBase(){    // Tenta usar a Property do UC. O modo de acesso pode variar por gerador;    // esta abordagem cobre os casos mais comuns.    try{      if(this && typeof this.GetProperty === 'function'){        const v = this.GetProperty('EndPoint');        if(v) return String(v);      }    }catch(e){}    try{      if(this && this.EndPoint) return String(this.EndPoint);    }catch(e){}    return 'http://localhost:8080';  }  async function loadRelease(API_BASE, kb){    const url = `${API_BASE}/datamon/updates?kb=${encodeURIComponent(kb)}`;    const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ao consultar ${url}`);    return await res.json();  }  async function streamDownload(url, filename, declaredSize){    const btn = qById('btnUpdate');    const wrap = qById('progressWrap');    const txt = qById('progressText');    if(btn) btn.disabled = true;    if(wrap){ wrap.style.display='block'; wrap.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); }    if(txt){ txt.style.display='block'; }    const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(`Falha no download: HTTP ${res.status}`);    const contentLengthHeader = res.headers.get('content-length');    const total = contentLengthHeader ? Number(contentLengthHeader) : Number(declaredSize || 0);    const reader = res.body && res.body.getReader ? res.body.getReader() : null;    // Fallback sem stream    if(!reader){      const blob = await res.blob();      const a = document.createElement('a');      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);      a.download = filename;      document.body.appendChild(a);      a.click();      a.remove();      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);      updateProgressUI(100, '100% • download complete');      toast('Parabéns pela atualização!');      if(btn) btn.disabled = false;      return;    }    const chunks = [];    let received = 0;    updateProgressUI(1, '1% • downloading...');    while(true){      const {done, value} = await reader.read();      if(done) break;      chunks.push(value);      received += value.byteLength;      if(total && total > 0){        const percent = Math.floor((received / total) * 100);        updateProgressUI(percent, `${percent}% • ${fmtBytes(received)} / ${fmtBytes(total)}`);      }else{        // indeterminado: sobe até 95% baseado em recebido        const pseudo = Math.min(95, Math.floor(received / (1024*256)));        updateProgressUI(pseudo, `${pseudo}% • ${fmtBytes(received)} downloaded`);      }    }    const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'application/octet-stream' });    const a = document.createElement('a');    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);    a.download = filename;    document.body.appendChild(a);    a.click();    a.remove();    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);    updateProgressUI(100, '100% • download complete');    toast('Parabéns pela atualização!');    if(btn) btn.disabled = false;  }  // =============================  // 6) INIT  // =============================  (async () => {    const ready = await waitForDomReady();    if(!ready){      console.warn('UC: DOM do controle não ficou pronto no tempo esperado.');      return;    }    const API_BASE = getApiBase.call(this);    const kb = (qs('kb') || 'texplusnet').trim();    const currentVersionParam = (qs('current') || qs('version') || '—').trim();    setTextId('kbName', kb);    setTextId('currentVersion', currentVersionParam || '682');    try{      const data = await loadRelease(API_BASE, kb);      const latest = data && data.latestVersion ? String(data.latestVersion) : '';      const latestInt = toIntSafe(latest);      const currentInt = toIntSafe(currentVersionParam);      setTextId('latestVersion', latest || '—');      setHtmlId('notes', (data && data.releaseNotes) ? data.releaseNotes : '—');      if(data && data.mandatory) showId('mandatoryPill');      const art = (data && data.artifact) ? data.artifact : null;      if(art){        setTextId('sha', art.sha256 || '—');        setTextId('size', fmtBytes(art.size));        // Release date & days since + flag        if(art.builtAt){          const releaseDate = new Date(art.builtAt);          const tz = 'America/Sao_Paulo';          const dtf = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { dateStyle:'long', timeZone: tz });          const rtf = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat('en', { numeric:'auto' });          const now = new Date();          const msPerDay = 24*60*60*1000;          const diffMs = now.getTime() - releaseDate.getTime();          const days = Math.floor(diffMs / msPerDay);          const rel = days === 0 ? 'published today' : rtf.format(-days, 'day');          const releasedEl = qById('released');          if(releasedEl){            releasedEl.textContent = dtf.format(releaseDate);            releasedEl.setAttribute('datetime', releaseDate.toISOString());            releasedEl.title = rel;          }          setTextId('days', Math.max(0, days));          if(days <= 14){            const flag = qById('flag');            if(flag){              flag.hidden = false;              flag.textContent = (days === 0) ? 'Today' : 'New';            }          }        }        // Offer update only if latest > current        const shouldOffer =          (latestInt !== null && currentInt !== null)            ? (latestInt > currentInt)            : (String(latest).localeCompare(String(currentVersionParam), undefined, { numeric:true }) > 0);        const btn = qById('btnUpdate');        const a = qById('directLink');        if(shouldOffer && art.url && btn && a){          btn.textContent = `Download update to v${latest}`;          a.href = art.url;          a.textContent = 'Direct link';          showEl(btn);          showEl(a);          // Progress UI show on click          const wrap = qById('progressWrap');          const txt = qById('progressText');          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {            if(wrap){ wrap.style.display='block'; wrap.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); }            if(txt){ txt.style.display='block'; }          });          btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {            const fileParam = (art.url.split('file=')[1] || '').split('&')[0];            const filename = fileParam              ? decodeURIComponent(fileParam)              : `texplusnet_v${latest}.war`;            try{              updateProgressUI(0, 'Starting download...');              await streamDownload(art.url, filename, Number(art.size || 0));            }catch(e){              console.error(e);              toast('Erro no download. Tente novamente.');              btn.disabled = false;            }          }, { once:true });        }      }      console.log('UC: init OK', { API_BASE, kb, currentVersionParam, latest });    }catch(err){      console.error('UC: falha ao carregar release', err);      toast('Não foi possível carregar as informações de atualização.');    }  })();}).call(this);
